organization_note: Tencent Holdings Limited, incorporated in the Cayman Islands and listed in Hong Kong, is headquartered in Shenzhen. Its Tencent Hy Team develops the Hy models and publishes them under the Tencent-Hunyuan and tencent organizations, and Tencent Cloud operates TokenHub. The catalog names the developer Tencent and the operator Tencent Cloud, so both names belong to this record.
